frappe.name: call
frappe.returnDescription: Promise that resolves with server response object `r` containing `r.message`.
frappe.docstring: Sends an AJAX request to execute a whitelisted backend Python function on the server.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Configuration options object for backend RPC call.

frappe.name: xcall
frappe.returnDescription: Promise resolving directly to the `r.message` payload returned by the server.
frappe.docstring: Modern Promise-based shorthand for `frappe.call`. Can be directly `await`ed in async JavaScript functions.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Arguments payload dictionary passed to backend method.

frappe.signature: frappe.__(text: string, replace_args?: string[], context?: string): string
frappe.returnDescription: Translated string in the active user's language.
frappe.docstring: Translates text into the user's active session language.
frappe.example:
const label = __("Submit Salary Slip");
const greeting = __("Hello {0}", [user_name]);

frappe.name: msgprint
frappe.signature: frappe.msgprint(msg: string | object, title?: string, indicator?: string): void
frappe.docstring: Displays a popup modal message dialog to the user in the desk.

frappe.name: show_alert
frappe.signature: frappe.show_alert(message: string | object, seconds?: number): void
frappe.docstring: Shows a floating toast notification in the bottom right corner of the browser.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Toast notification message string or options object with message and indicator.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Display duration in seconds before auto-dismissing.

frappe.name: throw
frappe.returnDescription: Never returns — throws client exception and halts execution.
frappe.docstring: Displays a red error modal dialog and stops JavaScript execution.
frappe.example: frappe.throw(__("Please fill all mandatory fields before submitting."));

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Error message text or error options object.

frappe.name: confirm
frappe.signature: frappe.confirm(message: string, if_yes: () => void, if_no?: () => void): void
frappe.docstring: Displays a confirmation dialog asking the user to confirm or cancel an action.

parameters.name: message
parameters.structure: __("Are you sure you want to proceed?")
parameters.description: Confirmation question text displayed in dialog.

parameters.name: if_yes
parameters.description: Callback executed if user clicks Yes / Confirm.

parameters.name: if_no
parameters.description: Callback executed if user clicks No / Cancel.

frappe.name: prompt
frappe.signature: frappe.prompt(fields: object | object[], callback: (values: object) => void, title?: string, primary_action_label?: string): void
frappe.docstring: Renders a quick input dialog prompt to collect values from the user before executing an action.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Field definitions array or single field definition object.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Callback receiving the submitted form values.

parameters.name: primary_action_label
parameters.description: Label for the primary action button.

frappe.name: show_progress
frappe.signature: frappe.show_progress(title: string, count: number, total: number, description?: string): void
frappe.docstring: Displays a floating animated progress dialog with a progress bar in the desk UI.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Title displayed at top of progress dialog.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Descriptive subtitle below the progress bar.

frappe.name: hide_progress
frappe.docstring: Hides and dismisses the currently active progress dialog.

frappe.name: provide
frappe.returnDescription: The created or existing namespace object.
frappe.docstring: Initializes a nested namespace object on `window` (e.g. `frappe.provide('erpnext.accounts')`) to prevent `undefined` errors.

frappe.name: set_route
frappe.returnDescription: Promise resolving once page router navigates to destination.
frappe.docstring: Navigates the Frappe Single Page App to the given route.

parameters.name: ...path
parameters.description: Route segments array or comma-separated strings.

frappe.name: show_modal
frappe.docstring: Renders a Bootstrap modal dialog with custom HTML body content.

frappe.name: require
frappe.signature: frappe.require(assets: string | string[], callback?: () => void): Promise<void>
frappe.returnDescription: Promise resolving after all JS/CSS asset files are dynamically loaded and executed.
frappe.docstring: Dynamically loads JavaScript or CSS asset bundles on demand.

parameters.name: assets
parameters.description: Path or array of paths to JavaScript/CSS assets.

frappe.name: run_serially
frappe.returnDescription: Promise resolving when all async tasks in the queue have completed sequentially.
frappe.docstring: Executes an array of asynchronous Promise-returning functions in strict sequential order.

parameters.name: tasks
parameters.description: Array of zero-argument async task functions.

locals.name: locals
locals.returnDescription: In-memory document or child row object with current field values.
locals.docstring: Global client-side document store in Frappe. Contains in-memory representations of all loaded parent documents and child table rows indexed by DocType name (`cdt`) and Document Name / row ID (`cdn`). In child table triggers, `locals[cdt][cdn]` retrieves the exact row being modified.

parameters.name: cdn
parameters.description: Child Document Name / row identifier string.

frappe.globals.name: cur_frm
frappe.globals.docstring: Global reference to the currently open Form controller instance in the Desk. Provides access to `cur_frm.doc`, `cur_frm.set_value()`, `cur_frm.refresh_field()`, and form methods.

frappe.globals.name: cur_dialog
frappe.globals.returnDescription: Active Dialog controller instance or null.
frappe.globals.docstring: Global reference to the currently active open Dialog popup modal.

frappe.globals.name: cur_page
frappe.globals.docstring: Global reference to the currently active desk Page instance.

frappe.globals.name: cur_list
frappe.globals.docstring: Global reference to the currently open ListView controller instance.

frappe.globals.name: frappe.route_options
frappe.globals.returnDescription: Key-value dictionary of filter parameters for target route.
frappe.globals.docstring: Dictionary used to pass parameters and pre-set filter values when navigating between views via `frappe.set_route()`.

frappe.globals.name: frappe.session
frappe.globals.docstring: Contains user session data including `frappe.session.user` (email/username of logged in user) and `frappe.session.user_fullname`.
frappe.globals.example:
const currentUser = frappe.session.user;
console.log("Logged in as:", currentUser);

frappe.model.name: get_doc
frappe.model.returnDescription: Document or child table row object from local memory store (`locals[doctype][name]`).
frappe.model.docstring: Retrieves a document or child row object directly from the in-memory client `locals` store.
frappe.model.example:
const itemRow = frappe.model.get_doc(cdt, cdn);
console.log(itemRow.item_code, itemRow.rate);

frappe.model.name: get_value
frappe.model.signature: frappe.model.get_value(doctype: string, name: string, fieldname: string) -> any
frappe.model.returnDescription: Field value from client in-memory `locals` cache.
frappe.model.docstring: Retrieves field value from client in-memory cache (frappe.locals).

frappe.model.name: set_value
frappe.model.signature: frappe.model.set_value(cdt: string, cdn: string, fieldname: string | object, value?: any): Promise<any>
frappe.model.returnDescription: Promise that resolves once client scripts, formulas, and child table UI have recalculated.
frappe.model.docstring: Updates a field value on a child table row or memory document, triggering all client-side event handlers and formula recalculations. Always use `frappe.model.set_value` inside child table triggers instead of setting `row.qty = 5` directly.

parameters.name: cdn
parameters.description: Unique Child Document Name / row ID (cdn).

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: Fieldname string OR dictionary of multiple field key-value pairs.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: New field value to assign (omit if fieldname is an object).

frappe.model.name: add_child
frappe.model.signature: frappe.model.add_child(parent_doc: object, child_doctype: string, parentfield: string, idx?: number): object
frappe.model.returnDescription: Newly created child table row object added to `locals` and `parent_doc`.
frappe.model.docstring: Creates and adds a new child row into a parent document's child table array and registers it in `locals`.

parameters.name: idx
parameters.description: Optional 1-based index position in child table.

frappe.model.name: clear_table
frappe.model.returnDescription: None.
frappe.model.docstring: Clears all child rows in a document's child table and removes them from memory `locals`.

frappe.model.name: get_children
frappe.model.returnDescription: Array of child table row objects.
frappe.model.docstring: Returns all child table row objects belonging to a parent document's table field.

frappe.model.name: delete_doc
frappe.model.signature: frappe.model.delete_doc(doctype: string, docname: string, callback?: () => void): void
frappe.model.returnDescription: None.
frappe.model.docstring: Deletes a document from the server database and clears it from `locals`.

frappe.model.name: sync
frappe.model.returnDescription: Array of synchronized document references in `locals`.
frappe.model.docstring: Syncs raw document data into the client-side `locals` store.

parameters.name: doc
parameters.description: Document dictionary or list of documents to store.

frappe.model.name: with_doctype
frappe.model.returnDescription: None.
frappe.model.docstring: Ensures DocType metadata is loaded in memory before executing callback.

parameters.name: doctype
parameters.description: DocType name to load metadata for.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Callback executed when metadata is ready in client memory.

frappe.model.name: with_doc
frappe.model.signature: frappe.model.with_doc(doctype: string, docname: string, callback: () => void): void
frappe.model.returnDescription: None.
frappe.model.docstring: Ensures target document is loaded in `locals` (fetching from server if necessary) before running callback.

frappe.model.name: copy_doc
frappe.model.returnDescription: Cloned new document object stored in `locals` with temporary name `New DocType 1`.
frappe.model.docstring: Creates an in-memory clone of a document with cleared submission fields (`docstatus = 0`, `amended_from`, etc.).
frappe.model.example:
const newDoc = frappe.model.copy_doc(frm.doc);
frappe.set_route("Form", newDoc.doctype, newDoc.name);

parameters.name: from_amend
parameters.description: True if copying for an amendment.

frappe.model.name: open_mapped_doc
frappe.model.returnDescription: Promise resolving after mapped document is created and opened.
frappe.model.docstring: Calls a backend document mapping function and navigates to the newly mapped form.

parameters.name: opts
parameters.description: Options containing backend mapper `method` and source `frm`.

frappe.model.name: map_current_doc
frappe.model.returnDescription: Promise resolving after fields are mapped into the current form.
frappe.model.docstring: Maps fields and child tables from another document directly into the currently active open form.

frappe.model.name: is_submittable
frappe.model.returnDescription: True if DocType has `is_submittable: 1` enabled.
frappe.model.docstring: Checks if the specified DocType supports submission and cancellation workflows.

frappe.model.name: is_single
frappe.model.returnDescription: True if DocType is a Single type.
frappe.model.docstring: Checks if the specified DocType is a Single document (e.g. System Settings, Global Defaults).

frappe.model.name: is_tree
frappe.model.returnDescription: True if DocType is a hierarchical Tree DocType.
frappe.model.docstring: Checks if the specified DocType is organized as a Tree structure (e.g. Account, Cost Center).

frappe.model.name: can_create
frappe.model.returnDescription: True if current user has Create permission for this DocType.
frappe.model.docstring: Checks if the logged in user has permission to create new records of this DocType.

frappe.model.name: can_read
frappe.model.returnDescription: True if current user has Read permission.
frappe.model.docstring: Checks if the logged in user has read permissions for the specified DocType.

frappe.model.name: can_write
frappe.model.returnDescription: True if current user has Write permission.
frappe.model.docstring: Checks if the logged in user has edit/write permissions for the specified DocType.

frappe.model.name: can_delete
frappe.model.returnDescription: True if current user has Delete permission.
frappe.model.docstring: Checks if the logged in user has delete permissions for the specified DocType.

frappe.model.name: can_cancel
frappe.model.returnDescription: True if current user has Cancel permission.
frappe.model.docstring: Checks if the logged in user has permission to cancel submitted documents for this DocType.

frappe.web_form.name: on
frappe.web_form.docstring: Listens to Portal Web Form lifecycle events (`ready`, `before_load`, `after_load`, `validate`, `after_save`).

frappe.web_form.name: set_value
frappe.web_form.docstring: Sets field value inside a Portal Web Form.

frappe.web_form.name: get_value
frappe.web_form.returnDescription: Current input value in web form.
frappe.web_form.docstring: Reads input value from Portal Web Form.

frappe.web_form.name: set_df_property
frappe.web_form.docstring: Dynamically sets field property (reqd, hidden, read_only) in Portal Web Form.

frappe.listview_settings.name: add_fields
frappe.listview_settings.returnDescription: Array of database column names to fetch.
frappe.listview_settings.docstring: Specifies extra fields to fetch from the database when querying the DocType ListView.

frappe.listview_settings.name: get_indicator
frappe.listview_settings.docstring: Calculates the status badge indicator color and label for each row in the ListView.

frappe.listview_settings.name: onload
frappe.listview_settings.docstring: Hook triggered when ListView renders for this DocType. Used to add custom action buttons or custom filter bars.

frappe.db.name: get_value
frappe.db.signature: frappe.db.get_value(doctype: string, filters: string | object, fieldname: string | string[]): Promise<any>
frappe.db.returnDescription: Promise resolving with field value or object containing requested field values in `r.message`.
frappe.db.docstring: Queries the database for a single field or multiple fields from the client.

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: Field name or array of field names to fetch.

frappe.db.name: get_doc
frappe.db.returnDescription: Promise resolving with full document object including child tables.
frappe.db.docstring: Fetches a full document object with all child table rows from the server.

frappe.db.name: get_list
frappe.db.returnDescription: Promise resolving with array of matching record dictionaries.
frappe.db.docstring: Fetches a list of records from the database respecting user read permissions.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Query parameters dictionary (fields, filters, order_by, limit).

frappe.db.name: set_value
frappe.db.signature: frappe.db.set_value(doctype: string, name: string, fieldname: string | object, value?: any): Promise<any>
frappe.db.returnDescription: Promise resolving after database update completes.
frappe.db.docstring: Directly updates a field or fields on a server database record from client-side JavaScript without opening the document form.

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: Fieldname to update or object containing multiple field-value pairs.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to write (omit if fieldname is an object).

frappe.db.name: count
frappe.db.returnDescription: Promise resolving with total record count number.
frappe.db.docstring: Counts matching records in the database table.

frappe.db.name: exists
frappe.db.signature: frappe.db.exists(doctype: string, name: string | object): Promise<boolean>
frappe.db.returnDescription: Promise resolving with true if record exists, false otherwise.
frappe.db.docstring: Checks whether a record exists in the database table matching the name or filter criteria.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Document name ID string or filter criteria dictionary.

frappe.db.name: insert
frappe.db.returnDescription: Promise resolving with the newly created document object.
frappe.db.docstring: Creates and inserts a new document directly into the database from client JavaScript.

parameters.name: doc
parameters.description: Document dictionary including `doctype` and mandatory fields.

frappe.ui.Dialog.name: show
frappe.ui.Dialog.docstring: Opens and renders the dialog popup modal on screen.

frappe.ui.Dialog.name: hide
frappe.ui.Dialog.docstring: Closes and hides the dialog popup modal.

frappe.ui.Dialog.name: get_values
frappe.ui.Dialog.returnDescription: Dictionary of field values, or null if mandatory validation fails.
frappe.ui.Dialog.docstring: Validates inputs and returns all user-entered field values as a key-value object.

frappe.ui.Dialog.name: set_value
frappe.ui.Dialog.docstring: Sets the value of a specific field inside the dialog input form.

frappe.ui.Dialog.name: set_values
frappe.ui.Dialog.docstring: Sets multiple field values simultaneously inside the dialog input form.

frappe.ui.Dialog.name: set_primary_action
frappe.ui.Dialog.docstring: Sets or updates the primary button action handler and button label on the dialog modal.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Handler callback executed when primary button is clicked.

frappe.ui.Dialog.name: clear
frappe.ui.Dialog.docstring: Clears and resets all input field values in the dialog to their default empty states.

frappe.ui.Dialog.name: get_field
frappe.ui.Dialog.returnDescription: Control object for the dialog field.
frappe.ui.Dialog.docstring: Returns the Frappe control object for a field inside the dialog (allowing `.df`, `.$wrapper`, `.toggle()`).

frappe.datetime.name: nowdate
frappe.datetime.docstring: Returns today's date formatted as a 'YYYY-MM-DD' string.

frappe.datetime.name: now_datetime
frappe.datetime.docstring: Returns current system date and time formatted string.

frappe.datetime.name: add_days
frappe.datetime.docstring: Adds or subtracts N days from a date string.

frappe.datetime.name: add_months
frappe.datetime.docstring: Adds or subtracts N calendar months from a date string.

parameters.name: months
parameters.description: Number of months to add or subtract.

frappe.datetime.name: get_diff
frappe.datetime.returnDescription: Difference in days between d1 and d2 (d1 - d2).
frappe.datetime.docstring: Calculates difference in days between two date strings.

frappe.datetime.name: get_hour_diff
frappe.datetime.returnDescription: Difference in fractional hours between timestamps.
frappe.datetime.docstring: Calculates difference in hours between two timestamp strings.

frappe.datetime.name: str_to_user
frappe.datetime.returnDescription: Date formatted according to active user's system date format preferences (e.g. 'DD-MM-YYYY' or 'MM/DD/YYYY').
frappe.datetime.docstring: Converts standard ISO date string ('YYYY-MM-DD') into user's preferred display date format.

frappe.datetime.name: prettyDate
frappe.datetime.returnDescription: Human-friendly relative time (e.g. '2 hours ago', 'just now').
frappe.datetime.docstring: Formats a timestamp into human-readable relative duration.

frappe.realtime.name: on
frappe.realtime.signature: frappe.realtime.on(event: string, callback: (data: any) => void): void
frappe.realtime.docstring: Listens to real-time WebSocket events published from backend Python workers (`frappe.publish_realtime`). Enables live UI updates without refreshing the browser.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Event name emitted from Python backend via `frappe.publish_realtime`.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Function executed when WebSocket event payload arrives.

frappe.realtime.name: off
frappe.realtime.docstring: Removes a registered WebSocket real-time event listener to prevent duplicate triggers.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Event name identifier to unsubscribe from.

frappe.realtime.name: publish
frappe.realtime.docstring: Publishes a real-time event from the browser to other connected users on the WebSocket channel.

frappe.ui.form.name: on
frappe.ui.form.docstring: Main entry point for all Frappe Client Scripts. Registers event listeners for form lifecycle events (`onload`, `refresh`, `validate`, `before_save`, `on_submit`) and field change triggers on parent and child DocTypes.

parameters.name: doctype
parameters.description: DocType name to attach listeners to.

parameters.name: handlers
parameters.description: Object dictionary mapping event names and fieldnames to callback functions.

frappe.router.name: set_route
frappe.router.returnDescription: Promise resolved when router navigation finishes.
frappe.router.docstring: Navigates the Frappe Single Page App to the given route.

frappe.router.name: get_route
frappe.router.docstring: Returns the current active router path segments as an array.

frappe.router.name: get_route_str
frappe.router.docstring: Returns the current active route joined with slashes.

frappe.utils.name: copy_to_clipboard
frappe.utils.docstring: Copies text to user's system clipboard and displays a desk notification toast.

frappe.utils.name: play_sound
frappe.utils.docstring: Plays a desk audio alert sound ('submit', 'cancel', 'error', 'click', 'email').

frappe.utils.name: get_form_link
frappe.utils.docstring: Generates an HTML hyperlink tag pointing directly to a document in desk.

frappe.utils.name: get_url
frappe.utils.docstring: Constructs a full absolute URL for the current site combining protocol, host, and path.

frappe.utils.name: filter_dict
frappe.utils.docstring: Filters an array of dictionary objects matching the key-value criteria in `filters`.

frappe.utils.name: comma_and
frappe.utils.returnDescription: Humanized comma-separated string (e.g. 'Apple, Banana and Orange').
frappe.utils.docstring: Formats a string array into a comma-separated list ending with 'and'.
